'''Piethet Brighteyes and the raiders of the Ryloth Ark''' was a major [[Youngling/Legends|childhood]] inspiration for<ref name="Warlords">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-2|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Warlords" /><ref name="MercyKill">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref> brothers [[Treuten Teradoc|Treuten]] and [[Kosh Teradoc]], who were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on<ref name="Warlords" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|I|239|Er'Kit}}</ref> [[Er'Kit/Legends|Er'Kit]]. Both brothers joined the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] to fulfill their dreams of playing at Piethet Brighteyes and the raiders of the [[Ryloth Ark]].<ref name="Warlords" /> The Ryloth Ark itself was a real artifact<ref name="SPIN">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-spy-game-spin-declassified|text=The ''Star Wars'' Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|int=The Star Wars Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|nolive=1}}</ref> associated with the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Piethet Brighteyes and the raiders of the Ryloth Ark was mentioned in part 2 of the article ''[[The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire]]'', written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and published on [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 17]], [[2013]].<ref name="Warlords" /> Its name is similar to the [[1981]] adventure film [[w:c:IndianaJones:Raiders of the Lost Ark|''Raiders of the Lost Ark'']], the first film in the [[Indiana Jones (franchise)|''Indiana Jones'' franchise]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref>
